objective: Replace the last non-geometric or visibly broken Mermaid terminal renderers so all 29 supported families produce genuine, readable deterministic geometry in Concise mode. Implement mermansi-owned native adapters for Gantt, GitGraph, Packet, and Class instead of the current merman-ascii structured-text or broken class output, and clean up Block routing. Gantt must draw a bounded dated timeline with section/task lanes, proportional task bars or milestone markers, exact task labels/date ranges/status flags, and visible ordering. GitGraph must draw branch lanes and connected commit nodes preserving branch membership, parent links, merges, cherry-picks, commit kinds, ids, messages, tags, current branch, and LR/TB/BT/RL direction where present. Packet must draw closed 32-bit word rows with contiguous field rectangles proportional to bit ranges, including fields spanning rows, exact bit ranges/counts/labels, and row boundaries. Class must draw closed compartment boxes for every class/interface/note, preserve annotations/members/methods/namespaces, and route every relationship as a continuous non-crossing-or-clearly-disambiguated path with endpoint relation kinds, line type, labels, and multi-inheritance intact. Block must preserve every node/group/spacer and semantic edge while removing duplicated unlabeled text legends and avoiding frame-like or disconnected-looking routes for cycles and reverse pairs; labeled edges must remain identifiable. Preserve Complete-mode canonical semantic models. Support Unicode and ASCII, English and Chinese display width, sanitization, deterministic output, ANSI-independent geometry, narrow dimensions, and typed width/height/cell/entity/depth limits before allocation. Add substantive semantic, closure, connection, proportionality, direction, bilingual, ASCII, determinism, and bounds tests; update AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md honestly. Do not modify or fork merman-core, merman-ascii, Selkie, or any parser. Apply KISS, YAGNI, DRY, and SOLID and reuse existing bounded Canvas/box primitives only where behavior is genuinely shared.

steps.description: Inspect repository structure, existing adapters (Gantt, GitGraph, Packet, Class, Block), dispatch logic in src/adapters/mod.rs, canvas/box utilities, and relevant test files.
Implement mermansi native adapter for Gantt diagrams with timeline ticks/dates, section/task lanes, proportional task bars, milestone markers, status flags, and bounds checks.
Implement mermansi native adapter for GitGraph diagrams with branch lanes, connected commit nodes, merge/parent connections, cherry-picks, tags, commit kinds, and direction support.

Implement mermansi native adapter for Packet diagrams with closed 32-bit word rows, contiguous field rectangles proportional to bit ranges (including multi-row fields), exact bit labels, and grid boundaries.
Implement mermansi native adapter for Class diagrams with compartment boxes for classes/interfaces/notes, member/annotation/namespace handling, and continuous clean relationship routing.
Clean up Block diagram rendering and routing to remove duplicated unlabeled text legends and improve cycle/reverse-pair routing while preserving nodes, groups, spacers, and labeled edges.

Update dispatch in src/adapters/mod.rs, public/crate exports, and update tests across support matrix, semantic integrity, bounds, and CLI suites, along with AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md.
Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy, and cargo test to verify all 29 supported families pass conformance and formatting checks.
